text_block_list.text: YEAAAAH!
text_block_list.name: BNW

text_block_list.text:
Today, three fine racers ran with all their
might
amid roars from the stands. Each
held the same
goal in her heart—to
achieve nothing less than
first place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I won't lose! I won't lose! I WON'T lose!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ticket's boundless determination to
seize victory
stirred the hearts of all who
witnessed it...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'M GONNA WIIIN!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
...and inspired each and every one of
them to
dream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит claims first! First place
goes to
Уиннинг Тикит!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: YESSSSS!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I'm first! I got first place!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I hate to admit it, but I lost. You ran
great.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: But next time, I'll be the one to win!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm defeated—well done.  The next time
we race,
though, I won't be letting you
have the victory. I
promise you that.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll be the winner.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I hear you, loud and clear!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You know, whenever we all race, it
really lights a
fire in my soul!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I have a lot of respect for you two.
You're my
special super rivals.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
So what I mean is, let's keep racing
together!
Next time, and the time after
too! I won't lose!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I'll accept your challenge any
time.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: All right! Let's do it!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sniff... Tickezo won... I'm so happy...
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Tickezo! Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: TIC-KE-ZO! TIC-KE-ZO!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text: Uwaaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
As the celebration increases, cheers for
Tickezo
resound through the whole
track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(It's like everyone's eyes are shining with

excitement!)
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: (They're all so happy for me!)
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит stands tall, looks up
toward the
audience, and cries out...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: THANK YOOOOUUU!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Her smile is as bright and warm as the
sun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
